defaults.motion_elements: the tiny lights inside the houses and the sugar snow
defaults.ambient: Tiny lights glow inside the gingerbread houses.

shots.subject: A street of gingerbread houses on a wooden table, thick royal icing snow on the roofs, gumdrop and candy-cane trims, tiny warm lights glowing through yellow boiled-sugar windows and a lit Christmas tree blurred behind
A gingerbread church with stained-glass windows of coloured boiled sugar glowing from inside, a steeple dripping with icing icicles and a sugar-snow churchyard behind a tiny pretzel fence
A single grand gingerbread house on a tall white porcelain cake stand, icing-covered roof and chimney, candy windows glowing, powdered-sugar snow around its base and a lit tree softly blurred behind
A gingerbread train with biscuit wheels and cars loaded with candies, standing on chocolate wafer rails that wind past gingerbread cottages with glowing windows
A gingerbread village arranged along a deep white window sill, each house glowing from inside, the real window behind showing snow falling on a dark garden
shots.motion_elements: the tiny lights inside the houses and the snow outside the window
shots.ambient: Tiny lights glow inside the gingerbread houses. Snow falls outside the window.

shots.subject: Gingerbread cottages around a pond of clear pale blue poured sugar glass, their tiny lights reflected in it, rosemary-sprig trees dusted with powdered sugar along the shore
shots.motion_elements: the tiny lights and their reflections in the sugar pond

shots.subject: A gingerbread village square with a tall tree made of stacked green star cookies strung with tiny lights, gingerbread houses around it and a cobbled path of chocolate pieces
A street-level view down a gingerbread lane, icing icicles hanging from the eaves right in front of the lens, glowing sugar windows receding into warm bokeh
shots.focus: the end of the gingerbread lane

shots.subject: A whole gingerbread village laid out on a long farmhouse dining table over a white linen runner, dozens of houses on a hill of icing snow, lit candles on the table and a decorated tree behind
shots.motion_elements: the tiny lights inside the houses and the candle flames
shots.ambient: Tiny lights glow inside the gingerbread houses. Candle flames flicker gently.

shots.subject: Gingerbread alpine chalets climbing a hill of meringue snow, ice-cream-cone pine trees frosted with green icing, a tiny light glowing in every window

A half-finished gingerbread house on a flour-dusted kitchen counter beside piping bags, bowls of candies and cookie cutters, a finished glowing gingerbread village behind it and a kitchen window with falling snow
shots.motion_elements: the tiny lights in the finished houses and the snow outside the window
shots.ambient: Tiny lights glow inside the finished houses. Snow falls outside the window.

shots.subject: The front of a gingerbread manor with piped white lace trim, a door wreath of green icing, a peppermint candy path and warm light glowing through its sugar-glass windows
A gingerbread bridge arching over a glossy river of dark chocolate glaze, gingerbread cottages on both banks with glowing windows reflected in the chocolate
A gingerbread village set along a mantel above a glowing fireplace, knitted stockings hanging below, every house lit from inside and a pine garland behind
shots.motion_elements: the tiny lights in the houses and the fire below
shots.ambient: Tiny lights glow inside the houses. The fire flickers below the mantel.

shots.subject: A gingerbread harbour village with a red and white striped candy lighthouse glowing at the tip of a biscuit pier, a sea of blue sugar glass and little cookie boats
shots.motion_elements: the lighthouse glow and the tiny lights in the houses
shots.ambient: The lighthouse lamp glows and pulses softly. Tiny lights glow inside the houses.

shots.subject: A gingerbread Christmas market of tiny biscuit stalls with striped candy awnings, strings of tiny lights between them and a cookie Christmas tree in the middle
A small gingerbread cottage under a glass cloche on a tea tray, a tiny light glowing inside it, teacups, a teapot and two lit candles beside the cloche
shots.motion_elements: the tiny light in the cottage, the candle flames and the steam from the teapot
shots.ambient: Candle flames flicker gently. Steam rises from the teapot.

shots.subject: A gingerbread village at night lit only by its glowing windows and strings of tiny lights across the icing snow, a dark window behind with snow falling
shots.motion_elements: the glowing windows, the tiny string lights and the snow outside the window
shots.ambient: Tiny lights glow inside the houses. Snow falls outside the window.

shots.subject: A tall gingerbread castle with ice-cream-cone turrets frosted in icing snow, gold-lit sugar-glass windows and little candy-cane poles on the towers
One gingerbread cottage window of yellow boiled-sugar glass glowing from within, icing snow on the sill, piped lace shutters and a tiny cookie wreath on the door beside it
